text:
Sam: Noticed a bunch of tenants (eg. tide-ops) getting billed under v1 because they intermittently omit x-rw-version. They expected v2 during SDK rollout.
Priya: We currently fallback to global default (v1) when header missing. We should add per-tenant "prefer-latest-on-missing" toggle in console.
Eli: Agreed. Also need telemetry to show requested_version vs routed_version so CS can explain charges.
Sam: Minimal plan: 1) short-term routing override for tide-ops (treat missing as v2, probe 20%) 2) add trace tags: version_source=(explicit|implicit) 3) billing view shows requested_version/routed_version columns.
Priya: Safety: start probe at 20% implicit->v2 and fallback-on-error to v1 for 5xxs. If error delta > 0.5% rollback.
Eli: I'll wire the telemetry tags and SQL for dashboard. Example query: SELECT tenant_id, routed_version, count(*) FROM requests WHERE headers['x-rw-version'] IS NULL GROUP BY tenant_id,routed_version;
metrics-bot: alert: implicit-routing-probe started for tenant=tide-ops probe=20% window=30m
Sam: Console copy must be explicit: "Routing preference only. Billing shows requested vs routed until policy changes."
Priya: Nina from docs will draft help center and console modal.
ops-bot: deploy: routing-override-tide-ops active probe=20%
Eli: First 10m looks fine, no noticeable 5xx increase. Continue sampling outputs for evaluation.
Sam: Action items: Sam/ops - override live, Eli - telemetry + dashboard, Priya - console toggle + modal. Will sync in 30m. Thanks.
